title: Ladakh announces hill council elections, but fails to assuage protesting civil society groups

ai.summary: Ladakh administration announced hill council elections for December 4, 2026, but civil society groups protested the timing amid winter conditions and stalled talks over statehood and Sixth Schedule status.

facts.claim: Ladakh administration announced hill council elections for December 4, 2026
facts.quote: Elections to all eight Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Councils (LAHDCs), covering 100 constituencies across Ladakh, will be held on December 4.

facts.claim: Civil society groups protested the timing amid winter conditions
Stalled talks over statehood and Sixth Schedule status
facts.quote: The shutdown call was issued by the Kargil Democratic Alliance (KDA), a socio-politico-religious grouping which has been holding talks with the Union government on the demands for Statehood and Sixth Schedule status.
